notes.title: patch 2/23/2024
notes.content:
-possibly fixed a bug where watching a replay in parallel play and pausing it could
cause crashes if left paused for long enough (needs testing)
-fixed a bug where original progress replays were being saved w/ the upgrades from the
save file
-fixed a bug where certain upgrades weren't getting taken into account on the first
run of a replay
-fixed a bug where the skin was wrong on leaderboard replays during the first run.
-modified the level Regenerate to introduce its mechanics cleaner and hopefully
be a bit smoother for new players. 
-added the ability to change sectors at the map select by pressing R2/L2 thanks to griff

notes.title: Patch 2/21/2024
notes.content:
Fixed some stuff from the first day of release:
-Fixed a bug where changing your resolution settings would cause the mouse cursor to disappear and make it difficult to back out of the menu.
-Fixed an oversight where runs would never upload to the leaderboard if they didn't beat your local record. This caused issues when doing runs in "Original Progression", because those times are usually worse than "Any Powers" runs. It now checks after map completion every time to see if a leaderboard score should be updated.
-Fixed a bug where when you change your controls in-game, the tutorial objects in the level would not reflect the changes in your button inputs.
-Removed a debug command accidentally left in to unlock every level.
